findings.title: Humanitarian Situation Report | 26 November 2026
findings.location: Khan Younis governorate, particularly Al Mawasi, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Public health and WASH response: Khan Younis accounted for half of reported acute watery diarrhoea cases across Gaza, and Al Mawasi alone for 22%, during the Health Cluster reporting period November 15–22. Reported acute watery diarrhoea cases declined slightly overall compared with the preceding week. These are shares of reported cases, not population incidence or a confirmed increase.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Khan Younis governorate accounted for half of all reported acute watery diarrhoea cases across Gaza
findings.source_type: Official UN humanitarian situation report citing Health Cluster

bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Newly recovered detail from today's report, not a new event within this hour. No claim of production novelty.
